name: Ideaflow
description: Ideaflow helps you search, filter, read, create, edit, organize, publish, delete, and restore personal notes and folders through Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Ideaflow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ideaflow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://prod-api.ideaflow.app/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ideaflow MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ideaflow lists 19 MCP tools, including create_note, delete_folder, delete_note, get_note_links, get_note_stats, get_notes_delta, link_notes, list_folders, list_hashtags, list_note_ids, list_notes, and publish_note.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Ideaflow?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Ideaflow in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Ideaflow requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Ideaflow is developed by IdeaFlow, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
